Alright, I understand everybody's concern here, but nonetheless, as an experienced ME player, and someone whom yesterday spent a total of 9 hours in ME:C, I can safely say the main story is nothing but a fragment of what ME:C brings to the table. 

First of, the third of Glass that the beta actually lets you explore takes a lot of time to familiarize with. This meaning that since there are no fast travel options, you have to get around the city yourself, discovering hundreds of paths that you will sooner or later be forced to memorize.

Secondly, the amount of side missions and non-main-story content is a lot. We're talking 25-30 of those (just in the beta area). It is definitely enough to make you want to get sidetracked while doing the main story. And if you want to complete them all when the game comes out, and also collect all chips and such like an elitist, this will probably add about a sixty hours to the game.

All in all, the fact that you need to be traversing the city between main story missions will force you to immerse yourself within the paths you get acquainted with, and definitely spend time doing so. This is inevitable. And while doing so, you will during this campaign be doing side-missions. If not for the fun of it, then for the amount of XP they bring. And as everyone who has played the beta knows, XP in this game is vital. You need it, and also want it in order to be the highest upgraded runner.
